reason: The plugin is a mobile remote-access extension for DeepSeek Harness: it enables an Android phone to connect to a LAN-hosted DSH Host and manage/inspect AI sessions, send turns, approve tools, and review artifacts from the phone.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在同一局域网内将 Android 手机与 DeepSeek Harness 的主机配对，实现移动端远程会话查看与交互（包括发送消息、工具审批与产物查看）。
summaries.en: This plugin enables an Android phone to pair over a LAN with a DeepSeek Harness host, so users can remotely view and interact with sessions, send turns, approve tool calls, and review artifacts from mobile.

capabilities: LAN pairing between an Android phone and a DSH Host
Remote session browsing and chat/trajectory viewing from mobile
Mobile initiation of new sessions and sending turns
Mobile approval workflow for pending tool calls
Artifact listing and per-device reviewed state on mobile
